WGU’s transfer rules

  • Up to 84 competency units from other sources can count toward the 112-unit degree.
  • WGU caps alternative credit at 84 competency units.

Source: WGU November 2026 undergraduate catalog: transfer ceiling and named degree requirements · Sophia WGU business current partnership table and March2026 change notice

Published university rate: $3,850 per 6 months. The number of paid terms depends on the work you finish. Outside courses and separate charges are additional. See the rate source.

Questions

Does Sophia Critical Thinking transfer to Western Governors University?

WGU’s published transfer guidance lists Sophia Critical Thinking for D265 Critical Thinking: Reason and Evidence (3 competency units) in the Information Technology Management – B.S., with conditions. Ask WGU to confirm it for your transcript before you pay for the course.

Does Sophia Introduction to Nutrition transfer to Western Governors University?

WGU’s published transfer guidance lists Sophia Introduction to Nutrition for C458 Health, Fitness, and Wellness (4 competency units) in the Information Technology Management – B.S., with conditions. Ask WGU to confirm it for your transcript before you pay for the course.

Does Sophia Human Biology transfer to Western Governors University?

WGU’s published transfer guidance lists Sophia Human Biology for C165 Integrated Physical Sciences (3 competency units) in the Information Technology Management – B.S., with conditions. Ask WGU to confirm it for your transcript before you pay for the course.

How many credits can I transfer into Western Governors University’s Information Technology Management – B.S.?

WGU’s published limit for this 112-unit degree is 84 competency units from other sources. This plan proposes 64 competency units through outside courses.

Which courses must I take at Western Governors University?

In this plan, 48 competency units are taken at WGU, including D428 Design Thinking for Business, E091 Building A Successful IT Organization, D370 IT Leadership Foundations, D388 Fundamentals of Spreadsheets and Data Presentations, D253 Values-Based Leadership and C724 Information Systems Management and 10 more.

Has Western Governors University confirmed this plan?

Not yet. Some course matches or open choices in this plan still need WGU’s confirmation. Questions to ask: Ask the school: how many credits must I earn at the school itself for this degree? Some of the school’s published rules for this program are still being confirmed. Ask the school to confirm this plan before paying for outside courses. Admission and your transcript evaluation are always WGU’s decisions.
